sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
while True:
    # press SPACE 20 times
    action(['SPACE']*20, intent='solve')
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print('Game over reached')
        break
    # safety break if too many iterations
    if current_frame.step > 5000:
        print('Too many steps')
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
